[SWS_SM_00627] Evaluation of NetworkHandle changes during an update ses-
sion
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
StateMachines
shall keep their
StateMachine State
, if the
StateMachine
is marked as "ImpactedByUpdate" and changes in a
NmNetworkHandle
are recog-
nized.
⌋
After preventing changes to the internal state,
Modelled Process
controlling
StateMachine
of type
Controller
needs to identify which parts of the
Machine
are affected and should transition any affected
StateMachines
to the
PrepareUp-
date
state. Identification can be based on the list that
Update and Configuration
Management
supplies as a parameter to the
PrepareUpdate
method. Additionally
any
StateMachine
of type
Agent
, that is affected by the update session, shall be
stopped as a part of preparation process.
